i.norm: Verifies the meta-encoding specifier produced for a RunCodec. The RunCodec has a run length k of 1825 and uses the canonical BYTE1 codec for both its A and B sub-codecs. When it is also passed as the "default for band" codec, getSpecifier encodes: - 122 : the leading byte (run-codec family, derived from k and the A/B default flags) - 113 : the kx value describing the run length - 1, 1 : the one-byte specifier of the BYTE1 codec, repeated for the A and B sub-codecs
